heroTitle: Building the Kingdom's Digital and Aerial Future
heroDescription: We empower Saudi talent with world-class skills in cybersecurity, software development, drones, and emerging technologies.
coderhubDescription: The platform teaches the core concepts of programming so learners can understand the topics clearly.
cyberhubDescription: An initiative to develop the potential students and support students clubs establishment in the Cybersecurity field in Saudi universities
satrDescription: Satr offers free, Arabic-first courses and learning paths for people who want to learn technology skills, from beginners to specialists. Topics include programming, app development (web, Android, iOS), cybersecurity, artificial intelligence and data science. The platform also provides programming books, bootcamps and challenges, and promotes self-paced, interactive learning as a national initiative.
